messages.en:
{07 00 00}Tee hee hee!{01 00 00 14 00} Everything
about this house is just
so totally{01 00 00 0a 00} you!
Interpret that however you
want.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hihihii!{01 00 00 14 00} Kõik selle
maja juures on lihtsalt
nii täiesti{01 00 00 0a 00} sinu moodi!
Tõlgenda seda, kuidas
tahad.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 05 00} It's so much cleaner
than I thought it would be!{01 00 00 05 00}
Not sparkling, but still...
{07 00 00}You really worked hard to
get this place all spiffy,
didn't you?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 05 00} Siin on palju puhtam
kui ma arvasin!{01 00 00 05 00}
Mitte säravpuhas, siiski...
{07 00 00}Sa nägid tõesti vaeva,
et see koht korda saada,
kas pole?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Well, well{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} It's a lot
cleaner {07 0b 00}than I'd expected.

{07 14 00}Actually, I always had the
impression that you lived
in filth, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nonii{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} Siin on palju
puhtam {07 0b 00}kui ma ootasin.

{07 14 00}Tegelikult oli mul alati
mulje, et sa elad
räpasuses, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
